purpose: Selection register for the mutually exclusive knowledge search default.
Kept separate because its candidates live in two different functional bundles.

when: Search should cover what already exists instead of what someone remembered to feed in.
Memory and index are wanted in one component, because GARDENER also carries memory.organic.
The index must not be able to reach the network at all.
strengths: The only candidate with network boundary local instead of optional; nothing can leave the machine.
Status active against the alternative's alpha.
Carries knowledge.index in addition to knowledge.search.
tradeoffs: No ui surface; library, cli and service only.
Does not provide knowledge.ingest, so document intake is not its job.
Its provides list names knowledge.search, not knowledge.search.default (see selection_notes).
evidence: registry:modules#GARDENER (provides memory.organic, knowledge.index, knowledge.search; boundaries.network local; status active; surfaces library, cli, service)

when: Documents have to be ingested and chunked first; search is the second step, not the first.
A graphical surface is expected, not only a library and a command line.
Optional LLM summarization is acceptable, including the network access it implies.
strengths: The only candidate that declares knowledge.search.default literally, and the only one with knowledge.ingest.
tradeoffs: Network boundary optional rather than local, because summarization may call out.
evidence: registry:modules#KnowledgeDigest (provides knowledge.ingest, knowledge.search, knowledge.search.default; boundaries.network optional; status alpha; surfaces library, cli, service, ui)

choice_groups.relationship_note: The two candidates are not interchangeable in scope: GARDENER indexes what already exists and also serves memory.organic, while KnowledgeDigest owns document intake. Selecting one as the search default does not remove the other from a stack.
choice_groups.selection_notes: Both may exist; only the default is exclusive, and the documented reason is addressability rather than quality: a router needs one unambiguous target. Source: .MODULES/ARCHITECTURE.md, 'Suche braucht einen Owner: knowledge.search.default = GARDENER oder KnowledgeDigest, nie beide zugleich als Standard'. The default flag follows the only candidate that declares the capability literally, not a quality verdict.
